column1: # The corpora, TAB-separated: name<TAB>path<TAB>reads<TAB>purpose
# Only `smoke` is committed. Everything else is real data living outside the
# repository, because this repository was just taken from 492 MB to 1 MB and
# putting gigabytes of fastq back into it would undo that.
# The committed one is an exception on isONform's precedent, and for its reason:
# a determinism gate that silently skips because its input is absent is worse
# than no gate, so CI's input is tracked rather than fetched.
# Path resolution: a path starting with `test/` is repo-relative; anything else
# is relative to $ISONCLUST_DATA (default ~/data/lrRNA-seq); an absolute path is
# used as-is.
# WHAT REPLACED sample_alz_2k.fastq, AND WHY
# The old fixture (2500 PacBio CCS reads) was real but blind: at --k 15 it gave
# BYTE-IDENTICAL output for --w 15 and --w 50, despite a 19x difference in
# minimizer density, so a port with a broken minimizer window would have passed
# every golden. On real SIRV ONT the same comparison gives 35 clusters vs 763.
# Even the 120-read smoke fixture separates them (70 vs 76). See PORTING.md,
# Finding 5.
# name
smoke
column4: committed. CI, goldens, the README install check. 54 of 68 SIRV transcripts, 7% simulated error, ground truth in every header

column1: sirv_sim_err0
column4: simulated, error-free. Exact per-read truth. The high-quality extreme: where an integral score can appear and reach Finding 6's float formatting

column1: sirv_sim_err7
column4: simulated, 7% error. Exact per-read truth (@read_N_from_SIRV612). Paired with err0, this is the error-rate axis with everything else held fixed

column1: sirv_real_10k
column4: real ONT. Truth is the transcriptome, not the read. Discriminates --w sharply (35 vs 763 clusters)

column1: sirv_real_100k
column4: real ONT, depth. For the --t sweep and for profiling

column1: sirv_pacbio
column4: real PacBio CCS. The --isoseq path on data it was designed for

column1: droso_20k
column4: real ONT, transcriptome scale, genome-only truth. THE ONE THAT REACHES FINDING 4: 937 of its reads have a homopolymer-compressed length in [k, w), the window-overrun zone that sample_alz_2k had zero of

column1: droso_100k
